ItemID: unavailable; Title: Live At Radio City Music Hall; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: A live blues-rock album sounds appealing, but I would choose a studio release this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: An Acoustic Evening At The Vienna Opera House; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Acoustic blues fits my recent listening, though it is not my first pick today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Muddy Wolf at Red Rocks; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The blues focus interests me, but I am only picking one album today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Second Hand Heart; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in blues and classic rock than country right now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Breeze: An Appreciation of JJ Cale; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: My interest in Old Sock makes this relaxed Clapton and JJ Cale material my strongest choice.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: 25; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone does not give me a clear connection to the music I have been enjoying.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Very Best Of; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Without an artist name, I cannot tell whether this compilation suits my taste.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Duets: Re-Working The Catalogue; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Familiar songs with a soulful approach could appeal, but I am not curious enough to choose it today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: I Still Do; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: More Clapton fits my interest in Old Sock, but The Breeze catches my attention first.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Old Yellow Moon; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its roots-oriented sound could suit my quieter listening, but blues is my priority today.
